Infers and visualises region-based covariation networks

Source: R/regionPanel_GRNTab.R
RegionPanel_GRNTab.Rd

UI and server logic for the Region-Based Covariation Network Inference panel, enabling users to infer, visualise, and compare covariation networks across user-defined regions or clusters in spatial omics data. Supports network inference, visualisation, and download of results for selected regions.

Usage

RegionPanel_GRNTabUI(id, metadata, show = TRUE)

RegionPanel_GRNTabServer(
  id,
  intensity.matrix,
  metadata,
  anno,
  bulk.metadata,
  shared_data
)

Arguments

id

Shiny module id (for both UI and server)

metadata

Data frame of sample or region metadata

show

Logical; whether to show the panel (default TRUE)

intensity.matrix

Matrix of intensities (features x samples)

anno

Data frame of peak annotations

bulk.metadata

Data frame of bulk sample metadata

shared_data

Reactive or shared data object

Value

UI: A shiny tabPanel object for the GRN tab. Server: None (side effects in Shiny module).

Details

  • Infer covariation networks for selected regions or clusters and compare across multiple regions.

  • Visualise the resulting network structure and the similarity between networks based on different regions.

  • Target metabolite peaks are used to build the network with a user-specified number of edges.

  • All network plots and results are available for download.
